architecture:
flowchart TB SC["iPhone Shortcut
reads Apple Health each morning"] subgraph supa["Supabase"] ING["Ingest function
checks the upload token"] RAW[("Raw readings
never changed")] Q["Analysis queue"] AN["Analysis
SQL, every minute"] RES[("Results
nights, baselines,
daily status, insights")] PLAN["Planner
11:30 and 8pm"] OUT["Notification outbox"] PUSH["Push sender function"] end APN["Apple push service"] APP["Web app on the iPhone
home-screen install"] VER["Vercel
static files only"] SC -->|"POST readings"| ING ING --> RAW ING --> Q RAW --> AN Q --> AN AN --> RES AN --> OUT PLAN --> OUT OUT --> PUSH PUSH --> APN APN -->|"notification"| APP RES -->|"reads its own rows"| APP VER -.->|"serves the app"| APP classDef store fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#3A3A3C,color:#000000; classDef ext fill:#F2F2F7,stroke:#C4C4C8,color:#3A3A3C; classDef notify fill:#FFF4E8,stroke:#E6CBAE,color:#8A4100; class RAW,RES store; class APN,VER ext; class OUT,PUSH,PLAN notify;
sequence:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant S as Shortcut
  participant I as Ingest
  participant D as Database
  participant P as Push sender
  participant W as Web app
  S->>I: ping
  I-->>S: not synced yet
  S->>I: POST readings
  I->>D: store, no duplicates, queue
  I-->>S: night_complete
  Note over S: saves "synced today"
  D->>D: every minute: today's status
  D->>D: queue the morning notification
  D->>P: due notifications (cron key)
  P->>W: push with status and reason
  W->>D: read its own rows
er_accounts:
erDiagram
  profiles ||--o{ upload_tokens : creates
  profiles ||--o{ push_subscriptions : registers
  profiles ||--o{ uploads : sends
  upload_tokens ||--o{ uploads : signs
  uploads ||--|{ samples : contains
  profiles ||--o{ workouts : "owner only"
  profiles {
    uuid user_id PK
    text display_name
    bool is_owner
    int latest_tz_offset_min
  }
  upload_tokens {
    uuid id PK
    uuid user_id FK
    text token_hash "SHA-256"
    time revoked_at
  }
  push_subscriptions {
    uuid id PK
    uuid user_id FK
    text endpoint
    time revoked_at
  }
  uploads {
    uuid id PK
    uuid token_id FK
    text kind "daily, backfill, ping"
    text status
  }
  samples {
    uuid id PK
    uuid upload_id FK
    text type
    num value
    text sample_hash UK "unique per user"
  }
  workouts {
    uuid id PK
    uuid user_id FK
    text activity
    int avg_hr
  }
er_answers:
erDiagram
  profiles ||--o{ consents : agrees
  profiles ||--o{ checkins : answers
  profiles ||--o{ followthrough : answers
  daily_status ||--o{ followthrough : "change days"
  daily_status ||--o{ notifications : triggers
  profiles ||--o{ notifications : receives
  consents {
    int version
    bool agreed_us_storage
    text ended_why
  }
  checkins {
    date date
    text answer
    bool is_first
  }
  followthrough {
    date date
    text answer
    text channel
  }
  notifications {
    date date UK
    text kind UK
    text status
  }
